SELECT mp.participant_id AS participantId, mp.meeting_id AS meetingId, mp.user_id AS userId,
mp.participant_status AS participantStatus, mp.input_status AS inputStatus,
mp.departure_name AS departureName, mp.departure_address AS departureAddress, mp.departure_latitude AS departureLatitude, mp.departure_longitude AS departureLongitude,
mp.return_name AS returnName, mp.return_address AS returnAddress, mp.return_latitude AS returnLatitude, mp.return_longitude AS returnLongitude,
mp.submitted_at AS submittedAt, mp.created_at AS createdAt, mp.updated_at AS updatedAt,
u.nickname AS nickname
FROM meeting_participants mp
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = mp.user_id
WHERE mp.participant_id = #{participantId}
